{{Quote|I never signed up for this cloak-and-dagger stuff. I was a regular soldier. Then one day, I put together a covert op raid that goes a little too well and--bam! I'm in Imperial Intelligence.|Captain Medle on his promotion to Imperial Intelligence|<ref name="The Spy" />}}
'''Medle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's a huge ancient Sith temple on Dromund Kaas. Used to just sit there being scary. Now the place is crawling with Sith sorcery, and it's been ordered a no-go zone for everyone. Naturally, we sent a team in. My commander led that team. Nobody came back. We can't report any of them dead without reporting the mission--which puts me in a bind.|Captain Medle|<ref name="The Spy" />}}
Formerly an Imperial soldier, he led a covert mission that he described as going "too well", which resulted in his transfer to Imperial Intelligence, which he did not enjoy.<ref name="The Spy" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> after [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gargun]] led a team into the [[Dark Temple]] and failed to return, Medle was unable to prove his superior's death to take his position and therefore hired a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] to enter the Dark Temple and recover the commander's insignia.<ref name="The Spy" />

{{GameDS}}
When Medle warned that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] did not want anyone in the temple, he could not risk them discovering that the bounty hunter had entered. As a result, he turned against the hunter. However, the bounty hunter later [[Death/Legends|killed]] Medle when he turned on the hunter.<ref name="The Spy" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Medle appears in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="The Spy" /> Medle was was voiced by [[Adam Leadbeater]].

If Medle is spared he would later send a letter to the Hunter with credits attached.{{fact}}
